description: This header file declares functions and includes dependencies related to disk image management and configuration within the Cuttlefish Android emulator project.

methods.name: ResolveInstanceFiles
methods.description: Resolves and obtains necessary instance-related files for the disk images.

methods.name: CreateDynamicDiskFiles
methods.description: Creates dynamic disk files based on the provided fetcher and configuration settings.

methods.name: DiskImageFlagsVectorization
methods.description: Converts disk image flags into a vectorized configuration within the provided Cuttlefish configuration.

methods.name: GetOsCompositeDiskConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the OS composite disk based on the given instance-specific configuration.

methods.name: OsCompositeDiskBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a disk builder for the OS composite disk using the given overall configuration and instance details.

methods.name: ApCompositeDiskBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a disk builder for the application partition composite disk using the provided configuration and instance details.
